column1: # depthSV phenotype manifest
# One row per analysis. Tab-separated, three columns:
#   name    a short label used in the output filename
#   method  linear | logistic | coxph
#   model   an R formula; the depth term must be named cov_resids
# The coverage PCs the correction removed are appended to every model by the
# analysis stage (--pcs/--ndim); they need not be written here.
# A binary response must be coded 0/1 or TRUE/FALSE, or be a two-level text
# column with the case named by --case-level; anything else is refused rather
# than guessed, because guessing once reversed effect directions.
# Adding a phenotype is a row here. Re-running skips analyses that already
# completed, so a sweep can be extended without repeating finished work.
# Column names must exist in the phenotype table passed as --pheno.
#name
quant_trait
null_trait
pc_null
case_status
case_label
survival
